prompt: Image 1 is a finished frame of an animation. Draw the very next key frame of the same shot: exactly the same camera angle, framing, scale, room, bed or floor, background, colors, line work, paper and lighting as image 1, and the same main character in the same place and size. Image 2 is the main character's reference: keep exactly its head, face, colors and markings. Its ear on the viewer's left is folded down and its ear on the viewer's right stands up, exactly as in the reference image, whichever way it turns; when the character is seen from behind, the folded ear is on the viewer's right The only change from image 1: the phone has slipped out of the main character's paws and now lies flat on its face, covering its eyes and nose, seen from its thin side edge and plain back; the main character's two front paws have dropped and lie limp on the blanket on both sides of its head; its mouth is a small surprised 'o' under the phone; the phone's glow now leaks only as a thin pale rim around its edges, the face under it is in shadow; the flame on the tip of its tail is the same tiny dim ember with a thin wisp of grey smoke. Everything else stays exactly as in image 1. Every surface is clean and unmarked: blank paper, blank screens, plain envelopes.
